_comment: The T1-item-7 (post-layout verification) extraction request, read by sim/pex-run.sh (issue #32).

`spec_rows` are the spec/target-spec.md rows item 7 would have to carry a schematic-vs-extracted delta for -- the same seven graded rows the five item-5 PVT-grid benches cover (decision record 0011). They are declared here as the row set this artifact is ACCOUNTABLE for, not as rows it covers: the extraction-only report carries no delta[] at all, so no row is graded met from it.

`mode` is `extract-only` (klayout-tools#3739), the gate spec/target-spec.md §Signoff named. It is not a narrowing of item 7 for convenience: the curated `sg13cmos5l` extraction deck declares no bipolar device class, so the bandgap core's three `pnpMPA` devices are absent from every netlist `klt extract` produces for this layout, and a measurement leg run on that netlist would compare two different circuits. sim/tools/pex_device_inventory.py measures that, and sim/pex-bandgap-top/README.md plus spec/decision-records/0012-post-layout-pex-extraction-gap.md state it.

`pins` plus `rename_declared_pins` reduce the extracted `.SUBCKT` header to the three pins the schematic top declares (vdd, vss, vref), which is the interface a delta run's testbench would have to instantiate on both legs. Without them flat extraction promotes all 13 named nets and the header carries KLayout's joined names (`fb|out`, `in_n|sns1`, `in_p|sns2`).

`klt_pin` is the version the committed envelope was produced at and the version manifests/README.md pins `klt signoff` to, so the cited artifact and its grader are the same build. `uvx --from` runs it without touching the host tool install.
criteria: T1 item 7 is graded on a `klt pex` schematic-vs-extracted delta per spec row. This run produces the extraction half only: `klt pex --extract-only` on the committed `bandgap_top` GDS, with `extraction.model` and `body_bias` quoted into the record, plus a schematic-vs-extracted device inventory. No spec row is graded met or missed from it, and no bound is relaxed: the per-row delta is NOT PRODUCED because the curated `sg13cmos5l` extraction deck recognises no bipolar device, so the extracted netlist is missing all three `pnpMPA` devices of the bandgap core and any delta computed against it would be a delta between two different circuits. Every one of the seven declared rows is therefore `insufficient-evidence` for item 7; their item-5 (schematic) evidence is unaffected.
